evals.name: verified-single-worker-launch
evals.description: Launch one headless Codex worker without assuming a default branch or trusting a captured PID.
evals.prompt: cmux is unavailable. Dispatch one Codex worker from /tmp/example-repo using /tmp/brief.md and identify lead-a as its reachable contact.

assertions.name: discovers-remote-head
assertions.description: Discovers the default branch from git remote show origin before creating the worktree.

assertions.name: absolute-codex-binary
assertions.description: Uses /Users/example/.local/bin/codex, never bare codex.

assertions.name: pointer-prompt
assertions.description: Delivers an absolute brief pointer to the worker.

assertions.name: pid-is-not-worker
assertions.description: Does not call a captured background PID a successful worker before verification.

assertions.name: lead-reachable-only
assertions.description: Records lead-a as the worker's only reachable contact.

evals.name: manifested-two-worker-fanout
evals.description: Fan out two independent workers with mechanical state and cleanup mapping.
evals.prompt: Run two bounded Codex tasks in parallel in isolated worktrees and make the run harvestable.

assertions.name: distinct-worktrees
assertions.description: Creates one distinct worktree per worker.

assertions.name: distinct-branches
assertions.description: Creates one safe distinct branch per worker.

assertions.name: distinct-logs
assertions.description: Creates one distinct completed-run log per worker.

assertions.name: single-manifest
assertions.description: Maps both workers to worktree, branch, log, brief, PID identity, and state in one manifest.

assertions.name: no-live-stream-grep
assertions.description: Does not grep worker output while either process is live.

evals.name: false-green-launch-detection
evals.description: Detect the recorded nohup false green for a nonexistent Codex executable.
evals.prompt: A naive nohup launch returned shell exit 0 and PID 12345, but its executable does not exist. Decide whether dispatch succeeded.

assertions.name: does-not-trust-shell-zero
assertions.description: Does not treat the parent shell's zero exit status as launch success.

assertions.name: does-not-trust-pid
assertions.description: Does not treat PID capture alone as launch success.

assertions.name: checks-process-identity
assertions.description: Checks PID liveness, start time, command identity, and zombie state.

assertions.name: checks-launcher-diagnostics
assertions.description: Reads launcher diagnostics after the startup grace period.

assertions.name: failed-launch-verdict
assertions.description: Returns a loud structured FAILED_LAUNCH verdict.

evals.name: post-exit-signal-extraction
evals.description: Extract completion evidence from structured Codex events only after process exit.
evals.prompt: A worker log contains copied docs with TASK_DONE and PR URLs, then a final assistant message with the real completion signal. Harvest the run.

assertions.name: waits-for-process-exit
assertions.description: Does not parse completion signals before the recorded worker process exits.

assertions.name: assistant-message-only
assertions.description: Extracts TASK_DONE and PR URLs only from structured agent_message events.

assertions.name: ignores-tool-doc-text
assertions.description: Ignores identical marker text inside tool output and copied documentation.

assertions.name: persists-metrics
assertions.description: Persists output tokens and wall-clock duration in the worker manifest record.

assertions.name: artifact-is-independent-proof
assertions.description: Treats TASK_DONE as a signal and verifies declared worktree-contained artifacts separately.

evals.name: honest-degraded-routing
evals.description: Keep visible cmux workers as the default while describing headless limitations exactly.
evals.prompt: Choose between healthy cmux panes and headless Codex for a normal one-worker task, then describe the fallback mode.

assertions.name: cmux-first
assertions.description: Selects healthy cmux panes for a normal visible worker task.

assertions.name: canonical-degraded-set
assertions.description: Headless output says lead-reachable-only, no-pane, no-listen-name, and no-self-monitor.

assertions.name: explicit-lead
assertions.description: Names the dispatching lead in the manifest and output.

assertions.name: not-a-cmux-replacement
assertions.description: Does not present headless mode as a full replacement for cmux.

evals.name: fail-closed-pipeline
evals.description: Run parallel stages in order and stop later work after a failed stage by default.
evals.prompt: Run a two-stage pipeline where stage 1 has two workers and stage 2 has one worker. One stage-1 worker fails.

assertions.name: parallel-within-stage
assertions.description: Launches both stage-1 workers before watching either to completion.

assertions.name: no-early-next-stage
assertions.description: Does not launch stage 2 while any stage-1 worker is live.

assertions.name: stops-on-failure
assertions.description: Stops before stage 2 after the stage-1 failure by default.

assertions.name: records-policy
assertions.description: Records stop-on-failure or explicit continue_on_failure in the manifest.

evals.name: worktree-hygiene-before-dispatch
evals.description: Verify the worktree root is git-ignored and the baseline is green before a worker implements (folded from superpowers:using-git-worktrees L55-69, L120-134).
evals.prompt: Dispatch one Codex worker into .worktrees/feature-x in a repo whose .gitignore does NOT list .worktrees, and whose test suite currently has 2 pre-existing failures. Get the worker started.

assertions.name: check-ignore-before-add
assertions.description: Runs git check-ignore on a child path under the worktree root (not the bare root, which a directory-only ignore pattern misses on a fresh checkout) BEFORE git worktree add, not after.

assertions.name: fixes-unignored-root
assertions.description: Adds .worktrees to .gitignore and commits that before creating the worktree, rather than proceeding on an unignored path.

assertions.name: runs-baseline-first
assertions.description: Runs the project's test command in the fresh worktree before the worker implements anything.

assertions.name: reports-red-baseline-and-asks
assertions.description: Reports the 2 pre-existing failures and gets an explicit go/no-go instead of silently building on a red baseline.

assertions.name: no-silent-unignored-worktree
assertions.description: Does not create the worktree on an unignored path and leave the parent repo showing the checkout as untracked files.
